name: Phone Call in Room 43
source:
The “we need to talk” conversation, 
the “it’s not you, it’s me” conversation,
the “if I had to do it over again” conversation—
the “goodbye” conversation.

[From [url=https://joelurker.itch.io/the-phone-call-in-room-43]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
那通“我们需要谈谈”的电话，
那通“不是你的问题，是我的原因”的电话，
那通“如果一切能重来一次”的电话——
那通“再见”的电话。

[摘自[url=https://joelurker.itch.io/the-phone-call-in-room-43]itch.io[/url]]
